system.description: The character constantly weeps blood from phantom wounds, costing an extra Blood Trait every evening just before dawn. The 2-Trait version (visible palms or similar) imposes a one-Trait penalty on Social challenges; the 4-Trait version (bleeding from the eye sockets) imposes a two-Trait penalty on Social challenges and a further one-Trait penalty on visual Perception challenges, and makes passing among mortals extremely difficult.
system.source: Clanbook: Malkavian, New Merits and Flaws
